CREDIT AGREEMENT
DISTRESSED CORP (Covenant-Lite Structure)
Dated: March 2024

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ARTICLE I - DEFINITIONS
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

"Consolidated EBITDA" means, for any period, net income plus:

(a) interest expense, income tax expense, depreciation, and amortization;

(b) non-cash charges and expenses, including:
    (i) stock-based compensation expense;
    (ii) write-offs and write-downs;
    (iii) non-cash losses on asset dispositions;

(c) restructuring charges, severance costs, and facility closure expenses;

(d) one-time transaction expenses related to acquisitions, dispositions, or refinancings;

(e) run-rate cost savings expected to be realized within 18 months of implementation,
    as certified by a Financial Officer, not to exceed 20% of Consolidated EBITDA
    calculated without giving effect to this clause (e);

(f) run-rate synergies from acquisitions (actual or anticipated) expected to be
    realized within 24 months of the acquisition date, as certified by a Financial
    Officer, not to exceed 15% of Consolidated EBITDA;

(g) pro-forma EBITDA adjustments for any acquisition completed during the measurement
    period, calculated as if such acquisition had been consummated on the first day
    of such period;

(h) anticipated cost savings from pending or recently announced restructuring
    initiatives, reorganizations, or business optimization programs;

(i) extraordinary losses, non-recurring charges, and unusual expenses;

(j) future cost savings and operational improvements certified by the CFO.

RISK ASSESSMENT:
• Multiple forward-looking adjustments
• Synergies capped at 35% combined (clauses e+f)
• Pro-forma acquisition EBITDA
• Future savings with minimal documentation
• OVERALL: HIGHLY AGGRESSIVE DEFINITION
